title: mzPeak controlled vocabulary list
description: Describe the JSON format of the controlled vocabulary list, analogous to https://peptideatlas.org/tmp/mzML1.1.0.html#cvList

cv.description: Describe the JSON format of a controlled vocabulary, analogous to https://peptideatlas.org/tmp/mzML1.1.0.html#cv.

id.description: The short identifier used for this controlled vocabulary. This **SHOULD** also the primary namespace identifier from CURIEs defined in these controlled vocabularies, though there may be others.

version.description: The version for this controlled vocabulary, like a release number, date, or similar. The format of the version is controlled by the controlled vocabulary.

full_name.description: The declared name for the resource (e.g. The PSI-MS Controlled Vocabulary).

uri.description: The URI for the controlled vocabulary. The URI **SHOULD** refer a fixed version of controlled vocabulary.
